objective: Measure whether a down-refitted mixed-K3/K4 QSRT expert panel can reduce forward KLD while retaining a strictly smaller representation than the immutable 3.5-bpw EXL3 comparison panel.

source_weights.scope: the existing four-shard layer-3 BF16 source window

selection_inputs.candidate_selection_role: the only inputs permitted to choose a data-dependent K3/K4 allocation

prohibited_uses: select a K3 or K4 rate
select or fit a down target

base_representation.description: K3 gate and up encodes plus the already-frozen reconstructed-activation down refit, with the ordinary source-target K3 down encode retained wherever the refit was rejected

logical_byte_gate.serialized_gate: The allocation is not acceptable until a materialized GLM QSRT container charges headers, format directories, alignment, padding, scales, and the shared reconstruction table and remains strictly smaller than the comparison checkpoint.

fixed_exl3_rate_stratified_allocation.description: Promote every panel projection whose immutable EXL3 rate is at least four, cap the two EXL3 five-bit projections at K4, then spend the one remaining promotion in frozen expert and projection order.

k4_projections.reason: first remaining projection in frozen expert and projection order
EXL3 rate five capped at K4
EXL3 rate five capped at K4

complete_expert_selection_allocation.description: Encode every K4 projection once, assemble all eight legal K3/K4 tuples for every expert, and minimize pooled route-weighted complete-expert output squared error on the eight candidate-selection windows under the twelve-promotion budget.
complete_expert_selection_allocation.objective_boundary: The score evaluates the complete SwiGLU expert so gate, up, and down errors interact. It does not use per-matrix weight error as the acceptance objective.
complete_expert_selection_allocation.tie_break: For equal pooled objective values, choose the lexicographically earliest sequence of per-expert rate tuples in the frozen expert order and gate, up, down projection order.

acceptance.required_model_quality_measurement: paired forward KL divergence from the immutable BF16 teacher to each frozen candidate on document-disjoint reporting inputs
acceptance.primary_claim_boundary: A layer-3 expert panel is a mechanism screen; it cannot establish complete-checkpoint dominance.
